description: This file contains utility functions for Cypress tests related to dashboards in Apache Superset, including functions to get dataset and chart IDs, visit dashboards, and prepare dashboard filters.

methods.name: getDatasetId
methods.description: Looks up a dataset ID by table name via API request.

methods.name: getChartId
methods.description: Looks up a chart ID by slice name via API request.

methods.name: visitDashboard
methods.description: Visits a sample dashboard, optionally creating it first, and waits for relevant API calls.

methods.name: prepareDashboardFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures dashboard filters dynamically based on provided filter configurations.
